sloka: एवम् गुण गणैर् युक्ता यस्य स्युः कार्य साधकाः ।तस्य सिद्ध्यन्ति सर्वेऽर्था दूत वाक्य प्रचोदिताः ॥४-३-३५॥
transliteration: evam guṇa gaṇair yuktā yasya syuḥ kārya sādhakāḥ ।tasya siddhyanti sarve'rthā dūta vākya pracoditāḥ ॥4-3-35॥

translations.english: Whoever has such great taskmasters of great qualities as their envoys, can have all their goals accomplished, driven by their diplomatic skills.
